scenarios.name: Recovery Drive
scenarios.blurb: Buried in the midfield with the tyres to make it back. Track position is gone -- go and take it.

scenarios.name: Safety Car Gamble
scenarios.blurb: The safety car is out and the pit lane just got cheap. Take the free stop or hold track position.

scenarios.name: Cliff Edge
scenarios.blurb: A podium is in hand but the rubber is gone. Nurse it home or gamble on fresh tyres.
